criteria.requirement: Implement marshmallow.discriminated.DiscriminatedNested(discriminator,schemas,**kwargs) as a Field. schemas is a nonempty mapping of nonempty string tags to real Schema instances. Select by external discriminator, remove that tag before selected schema.load/dump(many=False), then restore it; do not mutate input. Preserve selected nested errors/unknown policy and partial propagation. Missing or unknown tags produce structured ValidationError at the tag. Schema outputs must be mappings not occupying the external tag; allow_none and normal field lifecycle still work. Do not guess schema variants.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
